item.title: RML to close early, programs canceled for Monday evening
item.description: Press release:The Richmond Memorial Library will close at 7 p.m. on Monday, December 29th, due to inclement weather. All meetings and programs scheduled for Monday evening have been cancelled. Please check our website at batavialibrary.org for all updates.
